Principles of Health Informatics

Health informatics — definition, data-information-knowledge-wisdom and benefits of health IT.

🎯 After this chapter you can

  • Define health informatics
  • Describe the data-information-knowledge-wisdom hierarchy
  • State the benefits of health information technology

In simple words

Health informatics is the use of information and technology to manage health data and improve patient care. It turns raw data into useful knowledge that supports decisions.

The DIKW hierarchy shows how data becomes wisdom: data → information → knowledge → wisdom.

DIKW hierarchy

Level Meaning Example
Data Raw facts Blood pressure 150/90
Information Data with meaning “The patient’s BP is high”
Knowledge Applied understanding “High BP needs treatment”
Wisdom Judicious action “Start this patient on medication and monitor”

Benefits of health IT

  • Legible, complete records.
  • Quick access to patient information.
  • Decision support (alerts, reminders).
  • Better coordination between teams.
  • Data for quality improvement and research.

🔴 Health informatics definition

Health informatics uses information and technology to manage health data and improve patient care and decisions.

Where the nurse uses this

  • Document accurately — accurate data becomes useful information.
  • Use decision support — heed alerts and reminders in the electronic record.
  • Access evidence — use electronic resources for best practice.
  • Protect data — keep patient information confidential and secure.
  • Participate in quality projects — use data to improve care.

🔴 Most important for exams

  1. Health informatics uses information and technology to manage health data and improve care.
  2. DIKW hierarchy: data, information, knowledge, wisdom.
  3. Data = raw facts; information = data with meaning.
  4. Knowledge = applied understanding; wisdom = judicious action.
  5. Benefits: legible records, quick access, decision support, better coordination.

⭐ Important for exams

  1. Accurate documentation produces reliable information.
  2. Clinical decision support gives alerts and reminders.
  3. Health IT supports research and quality improvement.
  4. Protect patient data confidentiality and security.

📌 Memory trick

DIKW: “D-I-K-W” — Data, Information, Knowledge, Wisdom. Say it like “dick-w” or spell it out.

60-second revision

  • Health informatics = IT to manage health data and improve care.
  • DIKW: data → information → knowledge → wisdom.
  • Benefits: legible records, quick access, decision support.
  • Accurate data → reliable information.
  • Protect patient data.

Test yourself

Health informatics is:

Answer: A. Health informatics uses information and technology to manage health data and improve patient care.

In DIKW, 'data' means:

Answer: B. Data are raw facts (e.g., blood pressure 150/90).

An example of information is:

Answer: B. “The patient’s BP is high” is data given meaning — that’s information.

A benefit of health IT is:

Answer: B. Health IT produces legible, complete records and quicker access to information.

Wisdom in DIKW means:

Answer: B. Wisdom is using knowledge to make sound decisions and take appropriate action.
